title: Xiankui Yang
text:
About Me
I am a Postdoctoral Scholar in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at the University of South Florida. I received my Ph.D. in Mathematics with a concentration in Statistics from the University of South Florida. My research interests include statistical methodology, optimal experimental design, computational statistics, optimization, and machine learning. My current research focuses on developing computational methods for multi-objective optimal design and exploring optimization-based approaches for statistical modeling and learning.

title: Research
text:
My research focuses on statistical methodology, optimal experimental design, computational statistics, optimization, and machine learning. I am particularly interested in developing computational methods for complex statistical problems, including multi-objective design optimization and robust statistical modeling.





01


Optimal Experimental Design


My research investigates computational approaches for constructing optimal experimental designs under multiple competing criteria. Current work focuses on multi-objective optimization involving I-, G-, and D-optimality and the construction of Pareto-optimal design sets.


Optimal Design Multi-objective Optimization Pareto Front




02


Sequential Experimental Design


My research also considers sequential experimental design, where new design points are selected adaptively using information obtained from previous observations. I am particularly interested in space-filling strategies and computational methods for sequentially exploring the design space while improving the efficiency of data collection.


Sequential Design Space-Filling Design Adaptive Design



Design Augmentation




03


Statistical Methodology & Robust Modeling


I study statistical modeling methods with particular interest in robustness and alternative estimation criteria. Recent work examines logistic regression under data contamination and compares likelihood-based estimation with distance-based methods for improving robustness to outliers.


Statistical Modeling Logistic Regression Robust Statistics




04


Computational Statistics & Machine Learning


I develop and apply computational optimization methods for statistical problems, with particular emphasis on particle swarm optimization and population-based algorithms. My work also explores machine learning methods and computational implementations using R, Python, and PyTorch.


Particle Swarm Optimization Machine Learning Scientific Computing
